en: Hand-colored view down a narrow, sunlit alley in an old European town. Tall buildings with green shutters and small balconies line both sides, with laundry hanging overhead. Several people in early 20th‑century dress walk along the street. On the right, a woman stands behind a counter in a dark shop doorway. The facade on the right shows a faded sign, and another hanging sign reads 'VINS'. At the bottom margin, printed text reads 'Corner of the old Town'.
